answer: Hello! 👋 Welcome to CFI College of Law. You can ask me about B.Com LL.B (Hons), BBA LL.B (Hons), admissions, eligibility, fees, scholarships, documents, facilities, campus life, or contact details.
CFI College of Law offers 5-year integrated law programmes: B.Com LL.B (Hons) and BBA LL.B (Hons). Both programmes combine legal studies with commerce/business learning and practical exposure.
The B.Com LL.B (Hons) is a 5-year integrated law programme blending legal education with commerce, finance, taxation, business advisory, legal drafting, internships and moot court training.

The BBA LL.B (Hons) is a 5-year integrated law programme combining legal studies with management and business skills. It is suitable for careers in law, corporate advisory, public service, policy-making and entrepreneurship.
Admissions are open for 2026. You can apply through the Admission Form. You may also read the complete Admission Procedure before applying.

The admission process includes checking eligibility, getting the prospectus/application form, preparing documents, submitting the application, entrance test or merit evaluation, interview/counselling, fee payment and final confirmation. View details here: Admission Procedure.

For B.Com LL.B (Hons) and BBA LL.B (Hons), candidates must have passed 10+2 or equivalent from a recognized board. Minimum aggregate marks are General: 45%, OBC: 42%, SC/ST: 40%. Students from Commerce, Science or Arts streams can apply. See: Eligibility Criteria.
Both B.Com LL.B (Hons) and BBA LL.B (Hons) are 5-year integrated law programmes spread across 10 semesters.

The fee structure page covers admission fee, tuition fee, examination fee, library fee, optional hostel fee and other applicable charges. CFI also mentions transparent fee structure, payment options and scholarships for eligible students. Visit: Fee Structure.

Documents generally required include Class 10 mark sheet/certificate, Class 12 mark sheet/certificate, Transfer Certificate, Character/Conduct Certificate, passport-size photographs, Aadhaar or valid ID, income certificate and caste/migration/domicile certificate if applicable. Full checklist: Documents Required.
Merit-based scholarships are available for eligible students as per government and institutional norms. You can start here: Scholarship Form or contact admissions through Contact Us.

The curriculum includes core law subjects such as Constitutional Law, Criminal Law, Contract Law, Family Law, Company Law, Administrative Law, Property Law, Environmental Law, Human Rights Law and Jurisprudence. B.Com LL.B includes commerce/finance subjects, while BBA LL.B includes management/business subjects. See B.Com LL.B and BBA LL.B.

Students receive practical exposure through moot courts, drafting, pleading, legal research, internships, workshops, seminars and legal aid activities. Learn more on Why Choose CFI? and the course pages: B.Com LL.B, BBA LL.B.

CFI focuses on career preparation through internships, practical training, faculty mentorship and industry exposure. Career paths include litigation, corporate law, compliance, taxation, banking law, judiciary, government services, legal research, consultancy, NGOs and entrepreneurship. Visit: Career & Placement.
CFI College of Law highlights experienced faculty mentorship, practical guidance and academic support for students. You can view the faculty section here: Faculty.

The campus includes modern classrooms, moot court facility, legal library, computer lab, auditorium, gym, outdoor sports field, cafeteria, lockers, recreational spaces, CCTV security, first aid, parking and accessibility support. More details: Infrastructure.
CFI provides a legal library and e-library resources to support legal research, study and academic excellence. You can explore more under Infrastructure.
Hostel fee is mentioned as optional in the fee structure. For current hostel availability and details, please contact the admissions team through Contact Us.
CFI College of Law mentions a convenient spot-pickup bus service for nearby students. For route and timing details, please contact the admissions team: Contact Us.
You can contact CFI College of Law at 8590759003 or 8590759004. Email: info@cficollegeoflaw.in / admissions@cficollegeoflaw.in. Visit: Contact Us.
CFI College of Law is located at Poyya P.O., Thrissur, Kerala – 680733, India. View details here: Contact Us.
CFI College of Law programmes are approved by the Bar Council of India (BCI) and affiliated with the University of Calicut. See programme details: B.Com LL.B and BBA LL.B.

CFI combines rigorous academics, practical exposure, moot court training, legal aid clinics, internships, workshops, experienced faculty and a supportive campus environment. Read more: Why Choose CFI?.
Campus life at CFI includes student clubs, annual moot court, outreach and legal aid activities, workshops, seminars, sports, cultural events and student development activities. Explore: Campus Life.
